params.body:
`composer audit --locked` fails on every pull request since 2026-10-23. Advisory GHSA-mhf7-xp6r-6qrc (medium) affects Livewire 4.3.0 up to 4.4.7: `#[Authorize]` could be bypassed through reordered parameter keys and the `#[Json]` execution order. Platform #1044 is red on that job alone.

The fix is Livewire 4.4.8. It sits within the `^4.4` constraint in `composer.json`, so only `composer.lock` changes (`composer update livewire/livewire`). Livewire's assets are not published to `public/`, so nothing else changes.

Checked locally: `composer audit --locked` reports no advisories, and the full suite passes on 4.4.8 (3140 tests, the usual notices and skips).

After merging, #1044's CI is still red on its old run. Pressing "Update branch" on #1044 starts a fresh run.
params.title: Move Livewire to 4.4.8: authorization bypass advisory on 4.3.0 to 4.4.7
